module: Node "Reset Vehicle" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tag reset). Resets the vehicle to its initial state: `veh:requestReset(RESET_PHYSICS)` then `veh:resetBrokenFlexMesh()`. Input pin: `vehId`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: Called every frame while the flow is active: use a pulse for a single reset.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Requests a physics reset of the vehicle and resets its broken flexmeshes to zero.
